name: 56093 · Waseca, MN
findings: ZIP 56093 (Waseca) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56093 (Waseca) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56093 (Waseca) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
